0x000770.en: 「So... this is as far as I go...!」

0x0007A2.en: 「With my skills now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000813.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x00089B.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000915.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x0009FC.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000AC5.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000B00.en: 「No way I screw up here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000B54.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000BC8.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000CA5.en: 「So this is it...... the rest is yours.」

0x000CD7.en: 「Damn it...!@　Is this as far as I go!」

0x000D51.en: 「No good, took too many hits...... retreating!」

0x000D9E.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DDC.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000E23.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000ECE.en: 「Ngh...... so I become a shooting star...... ejecting!」

0x000FC6.en: 「Well now, they went and got me!」

0x00100A.en: 「Nn... gh! So this is my limit...!」

0x001077.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010BE.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x0010F3.en: 「Damn it! Is this all the strength I've got...!」

0x001137.en: 「Any more of this and I'm out of commission! Retreating!」

0x0011B0.en: 「Ngh...... you're as good as they say.」

0x0011DF.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I'm still green...!」

0x00122D.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! I'm pulling back!」

0x0012A6.en: 「Sorry, guys!@　I'm gettin' out of here...!」

0x0012E8.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001317.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001355.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001384.en: 「I can't do any more. Please excuse me.」

0x00140F.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll fall back for now...!」

0x001575.en: 「Ejecting now...@　Ngh...! Not a pretty exit...」

0x001633.en: 「Grrgh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001773.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x001908.en: 「......Did you reach the Steel Dragon Squadron?」

0x00193C.en: 「Yeah. Their first exercise just wrapped up.@　They accepted our request.@　They'll take the kid aboard the Hagane.」

0x0019EA.en: 「Thank goodness...... Now that child is saved.@ And he'll get to see everyone on the Hagane and Hiryu Kai again.」

0x001A73.en: 「But their units are still deployed, so@　the pilots are all out of the ship.」

0x001B03.en: 「Either way, the <Shura Rebellion> crew isn't all here.@ The <Special Combat Instruction Squad>'s in Izu, and besides......」

0x001B9A.en: 「Lt. Kyosuke Nanbu and 2nd Lt. Ryusei Date@　are still missing, after all......」

0x001C14.en: 「......The cause of that incident@　still isn't known, is it?」

0x001C6A.en: 「Right...... That wormhole from right after the Alteisen Riese@ vs. ART-1 mock battle at Tesla...... Its details are still unknown.」

0x001D39.en: 「Director Kazahara and Dr. Omiya suspected@　it might be a gate to a parallel world, but......」

0x001DC6.en: 「......It's possible. We planned our own project,@　sure, but we went through something similar.」

0x001E4D.en: 「Shadow Mirror, Einst, Shura......@　For whatever reason, this world may be prone@　to connecting with other worlds.」

0x001F0A.en: 「Lt. Kyosuke and 2nd Lt. Ryusei, right about now......」

0x001F50.en: 「They're fine, I'm sure. Those two...@　They'll definitely come back.」

0x001FE3.en: 「......All right, let's head for the Hagane.@　After that, I'd like to pay my respects to@　Col. Lefina on the Hiryu Kai, but......」

0x00207F.en: 「Hmm, wouldn't that be a bother for her?」

0x0020D8.en: →Stop by the Hiryu Kai;@→Don't stop by the Hiryu Kai

0x002123.en: 「I'd still like to at least say hello.@　We'll be passing near the Hiryu on the way back anyway.」

0x0021FF.en: 「All right, let's skip paying our respects@　to Col. Lefina.」

0x00226B.en: 「Thank you for taking the time@　to see us.」

0x0022C7.en: 「So what do you all plan to do from here?」

0x00230D.en: 「We'll head back to the Tesla Institute.@　We're still testing this Excellence Rescue,@　and we can't interfere with your exercises.」

0x0023D0.en: 「If you need anything later......@　Contact Fiona Gureden, sales rep for@　the L&E Corporation.」

0x002475.en: 「Understood. Please take great care.@　We'll continue investigating the unidentified@　unit you reported on our end as well.」

0x002523.en: 「We've alerted the Federation forces stationed@ in the surrounding waters too. If you encounter@ them again, send out a MAD.」

0x0025D7.en: 「Understood.@　I look forward to the day@　we can meet again.」

0x002650.en: 「......They've grown even more resilient,@　those kids, after the <Shura Rebellion>.」

0x0026BB.en: 「Now then, the deployment status of each unit?」

0x0026ED.en: 「They'll be in position in about ten minutes.」

0x002727.en: 「Then notify the Hagane. Once the@　Excellence Rescue leaves the exercise waters,@　we begin the second exercise.」

0x0027DF.en: 「Next is an exercise simulating a forced breakthrough...@　Without Lt. Kyosuke, how close can they@　get to the Hagane......」

0x002875.en: 「They can't use the SRX either......@　As I thought, without those two......」

0x0028DA.en: 「For now, all we can do is pray they're safe.」

0x00293C.en: 「Come now, those two have the devil's own luck.@　One of these days they'll just pop back up......」

0x0029A1.en: 「Captain, a powerful gravity-quake reading near the ship!」

0x0029E8.en: 「It's an ES wave of a pattern we've never seen!」

0x002AA8.en: 「Then, Lt. Col. Tetsuya Onodera......@　Please look after him.」

0x002B13.en: 「Yeah. What are you all planning to do now?」

0x002B50.en: 「Understood. Take great care.@　We'll keep investigating the unidentified@　unit you reported on our end too.」

0x002BEC.en: 「We've alerted the Federation forces stationed@ in the surrounding waters as well. If you run@ into them again, send out a MAD.」

0x002CA4.en: 「......Looks like they're working hard at all sorts of things, those two.」

0x002CFB.en: 「Captain, incoming from Dragon 2.@　Once the Excellence Rescue leaves the exercise@　waters, the second exercise will begin.」

0x002DAC.en: 「Understood.@　Relay to all units. Stand by until ordered.」

0x002E0C.en: 「Next is an exercise simulating a forced breakthrough.@　Whatever you do, don't let this ship take a hit.」

0x002E86.en: 「If Lt. Kyosuke were over there it'd be one thing......@　but I think we can manage somehow.」

0x002EF7.en: 「But we're down 2nd Lt. Ryusei on our side.@　Without the SRX, we may be in for a hard fight.」

0x002FC0.en: 「I know.@　But for now, all we can do is pray they're safe.」

0x003044.en: 「A-an ES wave of a pattern@　we've never seen before!」
